page.title: 3-minute demo video
page.intro: Seven timed shots with the voiceover for each. SerpApi carries the middle of the video: it finds launches (Google News, Ads Transparency), reads bank ads, and checks every lead on the bank's own site. Each step shows the screen to record and the calls behind it.

context.digest: cc-smith: Indian credit-card app. Checkout Advisor (which card), Card Finder (which to get), Notices (only about your own cards, plus a launch notice when a new card would earn >= Rs 2,000/yr and >= 15% of its fee incl GST), Market (Offers for you, New launches, What changed). Facts only from verbatim quotes on official bank pages; non-official = 'Reported'. SerpApi use (verified in code, backend/src/cc_smith/signals/sources.py, knowledge/discover.py, ops/serp.py): Launch Radar daily: google_news q='launches new credit card India when:30d'; google_ads_transparency_center for sbicard.com, hdfcbank.com, icicibank.com, axisbank.com region 2356 last 30 days, new = first shown in 14 days; ..._ad_details for up to 2 creatives per bank, image read by Haiku vision; google search site:<bank domain> to find official page/PDF. Gateway: rejects personal data, cache per flow (launch_radar 7 days), budgets per flow (card_profile 70, launch_radar 45, cap_watch 25, checkout_merchant 15, commerce_offers 10, dev 35; 50 demo reserve), ledger. Today: 26 live, 67 cached, all launch_radar; 224 left this month. Checkout/Finder do not call SerpApi. Today's 6 leads are all 'Reported' (none confirmed); launch notice shown only in test data. Bureau fetch and SMS/email budget import are simulated; the voiceover says so, the screens do not. The bureau feed names each exact catalogue card with open date, limit and balance; Add sets the fee month. Each held card's fee: Standard (catalogue), LTF, FYF or Custom amount (used by Finder and Notices). Onboarding is cards + spends only; reward type and fee limit are asked on Card Finder's first visit. Demo phone 98765 04569 -> HDFC Millennia ••4270 + SBI Cashback ••8286, CIBIL 762; import reads 42 transactions, budget about Rs 48,000/month (varies slightly per account). Demo figures: Swiggy Rs 1,200 -> both cards Rs 60, pay with Millennia and keep SBI Cashback for later (rules decide on a tie); Finder (Cashback, up to Rs 1,000) about Rs 26,400/yr today, best move +Rs 10,725/yr add Swiggy BLCK + HSBC Live+. Committed as 16b8bd6. Deadline 2026-10-10 18:00 IST, video under 3 minutes.

s1.title: 0:00–0:20 · Set up in two taps
s1.lede: Voiceover: “Indians hold 3 to 4 cards and still guess at checkout. cc-smith answers in rupees, from the bank's own words. Setup: with a one-time code we fetch your cards from the credit bureau, each named exactly with its fee, and build your budget from last month's card SMS and email — both simulated for this demo.”

s2.title: 0:20–0:45 · Which card at Swiggy?
s2.lede: Voiceover: “₹1,200 at Swiggy. Both cards earn ₹60, so cc-smith looks at the rest of your month: SBI Cashback's 5% covers more of your other spending, so pay with Millennia and keep SBI free. The maths is plain code; a small model only picks between the engine's figures when they differ. Every rate links to a quote on the bank's page.” No SerpApi call here: say so if asked.

s3.title: 0:45–1:25 · SerpApi finds new cards before we know their names
s3.lede: Voiceover: “The Market tab is fed by SerpApi. Every Monday morning Launch Radar runs Google News for card launches in India, and the Google Ads Transparency Center for new ads by SBI, HDFC, ICICI and Axis. Ad text arrives as images, so we pull the creative with SerpApi's ad-details engine and read it.”

s4.title: 1:25–1:55 · SerpApi checks every lead on the bank's own site
s4.lede: Voiceover: “News is not proof. For each lead we run a Google Search through SerpApi restricted to the bank's domain. Only a page on sbicard.com or hdfcbank.com can make a fact; everything else stays tagged ‘Reported’ — like these six today.”

s5.title: 1:55–2:20 · A confirmed launch is scored on your spends
s5.lede: Voiceover: “When the bank's page confirms a card, the engine scores it on your budget. If it would earn you at least ₹2,000 a year and 15% of its fee, it becomes a notice. Card Finder asks your reward type and fee limit the first time, then ranks the best 1 to 3 cards to add.”

s6.title: 2:20–2:45 · One gateway for every SerpApi call
s6.lede: Voiceover: “Every SerpApi call goes through one gateway: it refuses anything that looks like personal data, caches results, and holds a monthly budget per feature. The same gateway serves the nightly card refresh, which re-checks three cards a night on their bank's own site, so facts follow the bank's current page. Today: 26 live searches and 67 answered from cache.”

s7.title: 2:45–3:00 · Close
s7.lede: Voiceover: “Checkout advice from bank quotes, and a market feed powered by SerpApi. cc-smith.”

blocks.text: Code sent to +91 9876504569. Filled in automatically from the SMS.
Fee per card: Standard (bank's fee), LTF, FYF or Custom, editable later

msgs.what: The bureau step. **Simulated** for the demo: say it in the voiceover, not on screen. Phone 98765 04569 brings up HDFC Millennia and SBI Cashback.
Starts a fetch and returns a request id. The app fills the code in, as SMS autofill would.
The feed names each **exact card**, when it was opened, its limit and balance. The fee shown comes from our card catalogue. No "Which card is this?" step.
Add these cards: limit, balance, and the fee month from the open date. Each card's fee can later be set to Standard, LTF, FYF or Custom; Finder and Notices use a custom amount.
Reads last month's transactions (simulated SMS and email) and fills the budget from them. Totals vary a little per account.
Unpinned lines follow last month's actuals each new month; edited lines stay. Reward type and fee limit are not asked here: Card Finder asks them on its first visit.

blocks.text: Which card should I pay with?

items.label: Pay with
items.sub: keep SBI Cashback free for later

items.meta: 5% online, covers more of your month

msgs.what: The user types a merchant and amount, or scans a UPI QR.
One call: merchant, amount, channel.

Rules, caps and the **rest of the month**: both cards earn ₹60 here, but SBI Cashback's 5% online covers more of the budget, so using Millennia now leaves more for later. All sums are plain Python, no model.
Each rate is stored with the bank's verbatim quote and URL.
Haiku 4.5 picks and phrases the reason when cards differ; on a tie like this one the rules decide (decided_by: rules). If the model is slow (2.5 s), the rules decide too.
"Cashback SBI Card earns the same now; its 5% on online payments covers more of your spending, so keep it free for later." No SerpApi on this path.

Every caller uses this one function; there is no other path to SerpApi.
Phone numbers, emails, card digits and user ids are rejected: queries carry card and bank names only.
Same engine and parameters within the flow's cache time returns the stored answer.
A flow that reaches its monthly envelope stops; the 50-search demo reserve is spent only on purpose.
Logged in the credit ledger before caching, so a spent credit is never lost from the count.
Saved as a dated replay fixture, so tests and the demo run without spending credits.

g1.title: No live launch qualifies for a notice today
paras: The launch notice exists only in test data: none of today's 6 leads is confirmed by its bank and worth ₹2,000 a year on the demo budget.
On camera, say the rule over the Market list, or show the notice clearly marked as an example. Do not present it as live.

g2.title: Checkout and Finder do not call SerpApi
paras: The credit ledger shows SerpApi spend only for launch_radar. The 22 seeded cards' facts came from bank pages gathered during research.
Judges may check, so keep the SerpApi claims to Market, verification and the gateway.

g3.title: Nightly card refresh through SerpApi: built, not run live
paras: **Built.** A nightly job (03:00 IST, 3 cards a night, about a week for all 22) runs a SerpApi Google Search limited to each bank's domain, fetches the pages and reruns the quote and range checks. Unchanged values only bump their date; changed values show in Market › What changed.

It has not run live: the scheduler only starts with the server when SCHEDULER_ENABLED=true (off by default). Manual run: `uv run cc-smith refresh [card_id]`. Say it is built and scheduled, not that it has run today.
cap_watch, checkout_merchant and commerce_offers still have budgets but no job.

g4.title: Bureau and SMS import are simulated
paras: The screens no longer say so. The voiceover must say it once, in step 1.

g5.title: A re-run sweep today answers from cache
paras: Launch Radar results are cached for 7 days, so `uv run cc-smith radar` now returns cached answers and spends nothing. That is fine to show: it prints searches, leads and the credit counts. 224 live searches are left this month.
